title: How to Access Apple Live Chat Support
description: Link to the Apple support page: https://getsupport.apple.com/  In this video I bring you a tutorial on how to access Apple's Live Chat Support online with any issues you may have. Chat support is far easier than calling Apple or sending an email, although some of these technicians aren't the brightest. If you have any questions or requests, feel free to email me at [EMAIL] and be sure to hit that subscribe button for more amazing videos! ------------------------------­------------------------------­------------------------------­--- Follow me on Twitter: https://twitter.com/xm360yt  Follow me on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/XM360/app/212104595551052/

asr.full_text: What's up guys, expoxmod360 here and in today's video I'm going to bring you a short and simple little tutorial on how to access Apple's chat support feature online. So for anybody who has ever owned an Apple device or an Apple ID you'll know that these things do not come without their issues, nothing is perfect and when you do run into an issue you will want to contact support and if you're like me and many other people you won't want to use email because responses take too long and when you're on the phone, they put you on hold forever, you get a charge for a long distance call Stuff like that So the chat support is probably the most favored way of talking to the support team and if you Google apple chat support you don't get any simple answer what soeve there is no quick link or any quick way to get into chat support and it really does seem like there is no apple chat support, but there is, and I'll show you guys how to access that really quick. So what you guys want to do is if you have googled Apple chat support just click that first link right there, or you can just go to getsupport.apple.com, and once you've done that it's gonna bring you to a page that looks exactly like this one right here. Once you're on here, you're gonna click on iPhone and it doesn't matter if your problem is iPhone related or not. This is just how to get to chat support you're gonna click on, battery power and charging, and then you're here click iPhone or less, battery, power and charging, click on unable power, click chat to connect with them or receive phone serial number. If you don't have a serial number you can get one online, get a real one online, if your question is Apple ID related. If you are asking for a real issue definitely use your real email address and name. Giving them accurate information will help them solve your situation quicker, so once you've done that it'll bring you into the chat session and it should start up within two minutes you should get a response and like i said if you have an issue regarding your account or maybe like your apple id or something like that then just give them a random iphone serial number it doesn't really matter you just need to get into the chat and as you can see i've gotten a response right here but as i've noticed they will actually answer a wide variety of apple related questions they'll answer almost any question you have on any apple subject. Although you guys said that you had an iPhone battery issue in order to catch this chat, I know that they will also answer a lot of the questions you ask about apple products or at least try to answer it. To prove this to you, I asked my chat technician if he could help me out with an iMessage Problem, not a battery problem, and he said of course! You can ask them a wide variety of questions and I'm gonna get to another topic about How good their answers are really I'm going to talk about that in a second But this is just this is just a simple guide on how to get into the Apple chat support quickly so I just wanted to make this quick little guide for you guys today because Apple doesn't provide us with a quick little link that we can click to get into the chat support You do have to go onto our very specific category in order to get that option and I'm not sure if that's the only category that works maybe, other categories will give you a chat option as well I do know that this one works though so if you are trying to get into chat support that's how you would do it and now I'm going to quickly talk about their ability to help you out, that's a different story I have found them to be very unreliable and I'm going to give you guys a short little short little like personal example from my own experience. They'll be able to help you with the simplest, easiest questions that you can probably just answer by googling. But they won't be able to help you with the advanced stuff most of the time. When I upgraded from iOS 8 to iOS 9 I started having a big issue with my iMessage and it was this issue that was actually a iOS bug. It was nothing to do my phone I later found out and as of 2016 was actually able to help someone on a call. And I have this video, and I put it on my supervisor, but the person then told me that I I have cellular data off, I wasn't able to send text messages. Anybody who has spent 5 minutes in a phone store would know that phone plans consist of 3 things- texting, data, and calling. And they are not interdependent on one another- I can send message a text message without using data, I can call without using data, and I can use data without texting or calling. So I just found it outrageous that an Apple chat support technician would say something crazy thing that because I'm restricting the flow of data to my phone I'm not able to send text messages. I had data off at 250mb so I left data off and I'm able to send normal text messages just fine. I explained that to them and I was able to send normal text messages. And they told me that in the kindest words possible that I was stupid and to screw off. So there you have it! You may have a bad experience with any problem with them, but you never know? Maybe it was just me? Maybe it was the person, they woke up on the wrong side of the bed? Who knows? If that video comes to you in any way or if you already have one don't worry, it's pretty easy to get that on their channel already.
